integrity: Exact conclusions are conditional on the mathematical model and are not externally certified; generic dichotomous-density formulas and prescribed-pump covariance equations are acknowledged as prior work.
scientific_limitations: Ideal single-mode zero-detuning Gaussian thermal-Lindblad cavity under an independent classical on/off Markov parametric pump of fixed phase; only stationary intracavity measurements, not the emitted field; no pump depletion or nonlinear saturation.
title: Gaussian–Laplace–Pareto homodyne transition in a telegraph-pumped optical cavity
